+# 091: A fleet's goals
+
+status: approved
+serves: G-4, G-8
+
+## Problem
+
+Each repository of a fleet keeps its own goals, so the maintainer reads several directions to see where the fleet goes.
+
+## Behaviour
+
+`shipmill product show --fleet` lists each repository's goals beside the home repository's (`docs/product.md`).
+
+## Acceptance criteria
+
+- S-091-1: `shipmill product show --fleet` exits 0 and prints the home's goals first
+- S-091-2: each repository's own goals follow, under its name
+- S-091-3: a repository without `docs/product.md` prints `no direction`
+- S-091-4: an unreadable direction exits 2 naming the file
+
+## Out of scope
+
+Changing another repository's direction.
